description.text: A wide, high-ceilinged showroom stretches away from the camera, its far end sunk in near-total darkness.

The floor is laid in large polished slabs, so evenly finished that it behaves like dark glass, holding a faint mirror sheen even where almost no light reaches. Slender columns and pale ceiling panels recede toward the back wall in diminishing perspective, their edges barely distinguishable in the gloom, and the near half of the room rests in a cool, low-contrast half-light with no detail beyond soft gradients of grey.

At the rear of the floor a dark car sits facing the camera, motionless at first. Its shape reads mainly as silhouette: a low bonnet, a sloping windscreen, the thin horizontal bar of the grille, the glint of a chrome strip along the front edge. The paint holds only a dull, matte reflection of the room's ambient glow, and the tyres merge into the shadow beneath the body.

Then it moves. The car pulls forward at a slow, steady pace, and its headlights snap on, throwing two long cones of white light across the slabs ahead of the bumper. The beams strike the polished surface and bounce back up onto the bodywork, and a pair of bright streaks travels with the car as it advances. Dust motes drift through the beams where they cut across the open floor, and the light falls off quickly at the edges, leaving the corners of the room in a deep, flat black. Behind the car the empty floor it has left stays dark and undisturbed, and the black backdrop begins to peel away from its roof and shoulders.

Panel by panel the front end emerges into the light. The bonnet catches a broad soft highlight; the wings pick out a crisp curve; the shut lines of the doors and the reflective grille bar sharpen as the car crosses the boundary between shadow and lit floor. A stretched, wavering reflection of the car slides along the slabs underneath it, breaking into brighter fragments where the headlight beams hit.

By the end of the move the car sits in the middle of the lit showroom, headlights still burning, front end fully revealed and the floor around it glowing faintly. The car eases to a halt, the beams steady, and nothing else enters the space; the room stays empty and clean apart from the vehicle itself.
A faint, enclosed room ambience with a long, soft reverb tail; nothing else sounding yet.
A dark car rests in deep shadow at the far edge of
, facing the camera as a near-flat silhouette.
The car starts forward, easing off the mark, and its headlights switch on, cutting two white cones across the polished slabs.
A low engine hum rises smoothly as the car begins to move, joined by the soft slap of tyres on a polished floor.
The car reaches the boundary between shadow and lit floor; its bonnet, wings and grille bar catch the light and sharpen as the darkness falls away behind it.
The engine note steadies at a constant, unhurried level; the rolling of the tyres continues across the slabs.
The car settles to a halt in the lit centre of
, headlights still burning, a wavering reflection sliding to rest beneath it.
The engine settles into a quiet idle, and the room ambience returns to the foreground.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
